validity.researcher_notes: gem.wiki 403'd (Cloudflare, matches scope note), so no leads from the row's own citations; went straight to SNGPL primary sources (the company that owns/operates this exact corridor per the sister row P4079's confirmed sourcing). EXISTENCE + NAME PROVENANCE: 'SV1'/'QV1' are NOT ad-hoc GEM abbreviations -- they are SNGPL's own internal valve-assembly designators. SNGPL's FY2016/FY2017/FY2018 Annual Reports (statutory filings, each containing an audited 'Transmission System' asset table 'As at June 30, <year>') list, under 42-inch diameter, a chain of loop-line segments running exactly from the Sawan side to Qadirpur: 'SAWAN CUSTODY TRANSFER POINT-U/S OF SV1' (2.73km), 'SV1-SV2 LINE' (25.12km), 'SV2-SV4 SEGMENT' (55.33km in FY17/18; the FY16 table names this segment 'NARA CANAL D/S-SV4 LINE' at 51.52km instead -- an SNGPL-internal renaming/re-measurement between fiscal years, not a GEM discrepancy), 'SV4-SV5' (20.92km), and 'SV5-QV1 SEGMENT' (29.40km). Summed SV1-to-QV1: 129.69km (FY2016 table) or 133.50km (FY2017/FY2018 table) -- both within ~2% of GEM's 130.77km, i.e. GEM is tracking as one commercial pipeline exactly what SNGPL's own asset ledger books as five physically-loop-lined segments spanning the same SV1->QV1 range. This is a real, named, in-service SNGPL transmission asset, not a GEM-only entity -- confirmed via the company's own audited corporate filings across three consecutive fiscal years (FY2016, FY2017, FY2018), plus SNGPL's May 2014 internal newsletter describing the underlying capital project ('SNGPL's Board of Directors in its 422nd meeting held on April 29, 2014 has accorded approval' for a '42-dia x 109.3 KM pipeline... between Sawan-Qadirpur segment... at the estimated capital cost of Rs. 18,543 million', later put to OGRA for approval). The FY2016 Annual Report's own narrative table independently corroborates two DISTINCT prior phases on this same corridor: 'PROJECT IX' (2006-2013): '42-dia x 21.45 KM loop line... TRANSMISSION LOOP LINE BETWEEN SAWAN-QADIRPUR SEGMENT (FROM VALVE ASSEMBLY SV4 TO SV5)' (this is the SV4-SV5 segment, 20.92km as-built vs 21.45km as-planned -- consistent), and 'PROJECT X (PHASE II)' (2013-2015): '42-dia X 111 KM long Sawan-Qadirpur loop line (CTP to valve assembly SV4 and valve assembly SV5 to Qadirpur)... to transport additional 400 MMCFD RLNG downstream Sawan' (this covers the CTP-SV1, SV1-SV2, SV2-SV4, and SV5-QV1 segments together). NOTE ON THE 2014 NEWSLETTER: that document ALSO contains an apparently-inconsistent internal figure ('42-dia x 22 KM pipeline (pipeline being laid between Sawan-Qadirpur section)') in a different paragraph of the same article describing the SAME project -- almost certainly an SNGPL-internal drafting inconsistency (109.3km vs 22km for the same stated project) rather than a second physical pipeline; the later, more detailed FY2016-18 Annual Report segment tables resolve this by showing the true picture is multiple named sub-segments, not a single 22km or 109km pipe. CLASSIFICATION: confirmed transmission -- explicitly listed under the Annual Reports' 'Transmission System' heading, diameter 42in matching GEM's Diameter field exactly. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1=SNGPL 100% confirmed -- this is SNGPL's own asset register describing its own transmission system. LOCATION: StartLocation=Sawan / EndLocation=Qadirpur, both Sindh, confirmed by the SV(Sawan Valve)-to-QV1(Qadirpur Valve 1) span in the same source (and independently confirmed via the P4079 audit's Wikipedia field-location check for both place names, same corridor). DUPLICATE CHECK: NOT a duplicate of P4079 'Sawan-Qadirpur Gas Pipeline' (24in, 131.00km) -- that is a SEPARATE, older, smaller-diameter main line, listed as its own distinct asset-table row ('SAWAN-QADIRPUR', 24in, 131.00km) alongside P4101's five 42in loop segments in the SAME SNGPL tables; the two are parallel pipes on the same corridor at different diameters/vintages, consistent with the pattern already flagged (and cleared) in the P4079 shard. No other roster row overlaps this specific 42in SV1-QV1 span. SPEC: Diameter=42in -- exact match across all cited sources. Length=130.77km -- not materially disputed: sits between the FY2016 (129.69km) and FY2017/18 (133.50km) SNGPL segment-sum totals, i.e. within the company's own year-to-year measurement variance, so no spec concern is warranted. TIER CAVEAT: all corroborating documents (2014 newsletter, FY2016/17/18 Annual Reports) trace to the SAME company (SNGPL) rather than to genuinely separate origins, so per confidence_tiers.md this is graded medium, not high, despite being highly consistent across four separate fiscal-year filings; a truly independent second source (OGRA, business press) was not found this pass (WebSearch quota was exhausted mid-task; only WebFetch to known/guessed URLs was available). STATUS: operating is a reasonable inference -- these segments appear in the FY2018 (most recent checked) audited Transmission System asset table as in-service infrastructure, not as capital-work-in-progress; SNGPL's core business model requires this to remain in service to move Sawan-field gas onward. Capacity intentionally left blank/unfilled: the only capacity figures found (310->350 MMCFD, later 715 MMCFD system-wide target) describe combined Sawan-Qadirpur-Bhong SYSTEM capacity across multiple lines (P4079 + P4101 + downstream continuation), not a capacity specific to just this 42in SV1-QV1 segment -- per instructions, not fabricating a segment-specific number. Note the PDF url_verifier substring screen false-negatived on the 2016/2017 AR URLs for tokens like SAWAN/QADIRPUR despite the content genuinely being present (confirmed directly via pdftotext -layout on the downloaded PDF) -- a known large-PDF extractor limitation documented in url_verifier.py's own docstring; the 2018 AR URL happened to pass the SV1/QV1 substring screen and is used as the primary cited ref accordingly.
